svg.title: Lab 18 — New team environment factory
svg.desc: Terraform creates separate development and staging projects inside an existing Google Cloud organization folder. A keyless factory identity manages the projects, while versioned GCS remote state, budgets, project labels, authenticated Cloud Run sample services, and project-level log sinks feed a regional central Cloud Logging bucket. Project Creator's automatic Owner grant is removed after a controlled handoff.
svg.text: แพลตฟอร์มเตรียม Environment ให้ทีมใหม่

GCS · versioning · UBLA · public access prevention
